title: Genie agentic capabilities are now processed in India
body: Genie Code agentic capabilities, [Genie Agents](/aws/en/genie-agents) Agent mode, and chat in [Genie One](/aws/en/genie-one/chat) now process data within India for workspaces in India regions, without [cross-Geo processing](/aws/en/resources/databricks-geos#cross-geo-processing). For where each AI assistive feature processes data, see [Databricks Designated Services](/aws/en/resources/designated-services).
